newsitem.title: USA: IBM Credit Corp Q4 net slips.
newsitem.headline: IBM Credit Corp Q4 net slips.

text.p: IBM Credit Corp, a unit of International Business Machines Corp, said on Tuesday it had net earnings of $51.5 million in the fourth quarter 1996 versus $55.1 million in the same quarter last year.
The unit said its net earnings for 1996 were $271.1 million compared with $230.5 million in 1995.
Earlier IBM reported net income of $2.0 billion, or $3.93 per share, for the fourth quarter, versus $1.7 billion or $3.09 per share in the year-ago quarter.
IBM Credit was not immediately available to comment on why net earnings declined in the fourth quarter.
Total assets at December 31, 1996, were $12.9 billion, compared with $11.4 billion at year-end 1995, it said.
During 1996, IBM Credit said it originated $5.8 billion in capital equipment financing for end users, a 28 percent increase compared with 1995.
Capital equipment financing originated for end users in the fourth quarter of 1996 was $2.1 billion, an increase of 62 percent compared with the same 1995 period, the company said.
For the fourth quarter of 1996, working capital financing for distribution channels was $4.1 billion, a 28 percent increase compared with the same 1995 period, it said.
To support the increased financing volumes, total debt at December 31, 1996, rose to $8.1 billion from $7.6 billion at December 31, 1995, the company said.

W. Wilson Lowery Jr., chairman of IBM Credit and general manager, IBM customer financing, said. "Our customers have responded to our financing offerings with ever-increasing commitments, both in the United States and worldwide from IBM's other customer financing organizations."
